structure_expert.inputs: ESM2 sequence Transformer + pLDDT-aware C-alpha EGNN + all-atom chemical-site residual + optional PepFlow ensemble-statistics residual
structure_expert.conformer_fallback: hard-masked exact 3D-v2 fallback when conformer statistics are unavailable

prott5_expert.augmentation: 1:1 Borderline-SMOTE fitted inside each training fold

fusion.selection: leave-one-group-fold-out MCC optimization on training OOF only

interaction_adapter.inputs: residue-aligned frozen ProtT5 tokens + OOF-trained pLDDT-aware 3D residue states + 12D rotation-invariant chemical-site summaries
interaction_adapter.architecture: ProtT5-query one-way cross-attention with a local functional-site semantic gate and bounded zero-initialized logit residual
interaction_adapter.training: five group-aware OOF folds over immutable legacy-default probabilities; six-epoch full refit selected by the median OOF best epoch

bioemu_boundary_mixture.architecture: mutually exclusive pooled-ProtT5 consensus specialist or quality-conditioned BioEmu residual

cross_dimension_attention.architecture: 1D query token cross-attends to CAMC-3D, standalone BioEmu and BioEmu-BR3D evidence tokens
cross_dimension_attention.decision_protection: preserve the side of the frozen 0.60 threshold
cross_dimension_attention.selection: outer-fold prediction with disjoint rotating validation-fold BCE early stopping

bacc_decision_residual.architecture: one-hidden-layer 16-unit MLP gate over frozen ProtT5 and 1D+3D disagreement features
bacc_decision_residual.operation: change only the final class decision; preserve the BioEmu-XAttn calibrated probability
bacc_decision_residual.selection: group-aware cross-fitted OOF with ACC/F1/MCC/AUROC/AUPRC/SP/Brier/ECE nondegradation
bacc_decision_residual.complexity_rule: prefer the simplest eligible model within 0.001 OOF BACC of the best depth/epoch screen

inference.fallback_reason: the 0.62/0.38 weight was validated for full 3D-v2, not the historical 3D-v1 fallback
inference.missing_adapter_cache: use the retained pre-adapter 0.62/0.38 hybrid exactly; never synthesize residue tokens
inference.adapter_cache_requirement: aligned ProtT5 token, 3D residue-state and chemical-site cache generated without changing the frozen 0.60 threshold
inference.missing_default_assets: full-train boundary selector, pooled-ProtT5 boundary specialist, BioEmu benefit gate, BioEmu-BR3D specialist and cross-dimension attention checkpoints
